objective: Find incremental residual directions outside the reproducible clean baseline and current TEST submission span.
dense_source_policy: Inputs use the historical raw-derived mmap only after an experiment-local raw parity audit; eligibility and every target are rebuilt directly from raw parquet.

baseline.representation: cutoff-safe RFM context: per-channel sums and active-day counts over 7/14/30/60/90/180/365 days plus per-channel recency
baseline.cross_fit: global user hash halves for residual targets

A1_TREE_TRAJ_180.representation: 26 chronological weekly bins plus 28 daily bins for 11 raw channels, with limited RFM context

A1_TREE_TRAJ_365.representation: 53 chronological weekly bins plus 28 daily bins for 11 raw channels, with limited RFM context

A2_WEEKLY_RESIDUAL_CNN.representation: 53 chronological weekly bins for 11 raw channels through a width-32 residual dilated CNN (dilations 1/2/4), with limited RFM context

C_TEST_REGIME_MATCHED_A1_365.construction: target-free maximum-support subset matching by activity quartile and historical purchase-day class
C_TEST_REGIME_MATCHED_A1_365.selection_rule: continue only for >=10% rho lift, no latest degradation, and better nested Delta MSE

nested_amplitude: fold 1 fixed at 1.0 without held-out fitting; every later fold uses b/G pooled from strictly earlier held-out folds
